name: FabriPlas Metal
old_description: Processing Time 8-10 weeks from order placement. Please read Shop policies before purchase.
about:
FabriPlas Metal operates from Bennet, Nebraska, as a handmade, made-to-order metalworking shop. The company crafts decorative metal panels, privacy screens, and architectural inserts entirely in-house, using metal sheets sourced from the United States.

The product line includes over 60 standard designs such as wildlife, nature, geometric, and coastal-themed panels, as well as room dividers, fence toppers, railing inserts, and pergola panels. Standard panels are cut from 14-gauge mild steel (0.0747 in) with pre-drilled mounting holes and included hardware. The shop also works in aluminum, stainless steel, copper, and brass, offering custom fabrication of bent flanges, tabs, hinges, and custom graphics. All design and production are done in-house by a skilled team; the company does not mass-produce.

FabriPlas Metal serves architectural firms, contractors, interior designers, landscapers, and residential customers across all 50 states. The company highlights collaboration with industry professionals on architectural and outdoor projects, both indoor and outdoor.

The business emphasizes 100% American-made materials and labor, handcrafted quality over mass production, and in-house design control. It positions its differentiators as domestic sourcing, custom capability, and a high level of skill and attention to detail.

name: Fabric Depot & Supply
old_description: We hope everyone is Enjoying our Arizona summer and is staying Cool!
about:
Fabric Depot & Supply has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1991. The business is family-owned and opened its doors as a fabric resource for both consumers and local trade customers.

The company runs a large showroom stocking more than 750 fabrics and over 700 rolls, alongside 10-plus foam densities, batting, webbing, trim, and commercial adhesives. In-house upholstery and seamstress teams handle custom cushion fabrication, drapery, bedding, outdoor shade covers, and reupholstery for residential, automotive, and marine applications. The location also carries flooring lines including hardwood, laminate, carpet, and luxury vinyl, and serves as an authorized dealer for brands such as Sunbrella, Revolution, Outdura, and California Umbrella.

Customers range from homeowners and interior designers to automotive and marine upholstery shops, hospitality venues, and commercial contractors. The shop supplies auto carpet, headliners, and marine vinyl to transportation specialists, while its custom drapery and hardware programs serve residential and commercial window treatments. Local businesses also source foam, trim, and hardware for furniture production and refurbishment.

The operation distinguishes itself by combining a broad retail inventory with full-service fabrication under one roof, allowing clients to select materials and have them cut, sewn, and finished on site. The company emphasizes its ability to special-order virtually any fabric, foam shape, or drapery hardware configuration to meet project-specific requirements.

Fabric Mart operates from Aiea, Hawaii, supplying a broad range of Hawaiian-themed fabrics to customers worldwide. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The retailer stocks over 571 fabric SKUs, including cotton, poly/cotton blends, rayon, barkcloth, and traditional palaka prints, along with a selection of Hawaiian gifts. Orders are fulfilled through an e-commerce platform that offers international shipping, and the business also maintains physical store locations in Hawaii.

Fabric Mart's customer base consists primarily of individual consumers, quilters, and crafters seeking authentic Hawaiian patterns for apparel, home decor, and craft projects. The company ships orders globally, catering to both domestic and international buyers.

The business distinguishes itself by curating prints that reflect the diverse colors and motifs found across the Hawaiian islands, positioning itself as a specialty source for island-inspired textiles.

name: Fabric Textile Products, Inc.
old_description: We specialize in high quality home decor products. Take your designs and ideas to the next level.
about:
Based in Clifton, New Jersey, Fabric Textile Products, Inc. operates as a print-on-demand manufacturer and fulfillment provider for custom home decor products. The company emphasizes domestic production, with all printing and fulfillment conducted at its New Jersey facility.

The company specializes in made-to-order production of home decor items, offering a print-on-demand model that eliminates inventory risk for its clients. It accepts orders as small as a single unit and processes them through an integrated workflow that includes custom printing, personalized inserts, packaging, and direct shipping. The facility supports API integration for automated order routing, and the company states that orders leave the facility within 48 hours.

Fabric Textile Products serves e-commerce businesses and brands that sell custom home decor products. Its platform-agnostic approach allows clients to connect via their own API or the company's API, targeting sellers who want to outsource manufacturing and fulfillment without holding stock.

The company positions its domestic manufacturing and rapid turnaround as key differentiators, promoting a "no inventory risk" model that enables clients to scale without upfront production commitments. Its focus on made-in-USA production and same-facility fulfillment is intended to reduce lead times and simplify supply chains for small- to mid-sized online retailers.

name: FabricSpan
old_description: We serve you by providing a wide range of services and project capabilities. Our projects involve membrane structures and other architectural, commercial, and
about:
FabricSpan operates from Idaho Falls, Idaho, as a contract manufacturer specializing in fabric membrane structures for architectural, commercial, and industrial applications. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop provides end-to-end fabrication services including design and pattern development, material procurement, CNC cutting, RF welding, hot air welding, and industrial sewing. Its product range covers frame and tent structures, air-inflated structures, tensile and shade structures, facades, covers, liners, and air-supported structures. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

FabricSpan works with contractors, engineers, designers, architects, building owners, other manufacturers, and fabric suppliers. Notable projects include designing and manufacturing dual membrane roofs for a biomass anaerobic digester operated by Waste No Energy in Monticello, Indiana, and a custom tensioned-membrane building for Monticello Montessori. The company also serves the broader architectural, commercial, industrial, waste-management, and education sectors.

The company states that confidentiality is an essential part of its service, pledging to protect customers’ product development and project information. It emphasizes quality service and professionalism aimed at meeting customer expectations, though it does not articulate a specific founding mission beyond helping partners bring project ideas to life.

name: Fabricated Metals
old_description: Fabricated Metals is a U.S. based manufacturer who provides custom design and fabrication of metal products.
about:
Fabricated Metals operates from Louisville, Kentucky, where it was founded in 1955. The company remains a privately held, family-owned business, having grown from its origins as a metal fabrication shop into a preferred partner for original equipment manufacturers in the rail, transit, communication, and energy storage sectors.

The company provides full-service engineering, design, fabrication, and integration of custom metal products. Its core offerings include instrument houses, enclosures, junction boxes, battery cabinets, steel foundations, and submersible enclosures tested to withstand full immersion. Fabricated Metals runs high-production fabrication lines capable of working with steel up to 12 gauge, supporting both small and large-scale manufacturing runs.

Primary customers are OEMs in the railroad, communication, transit, power generation, and energy storage industries. The firm has developed specialized solutions for major railroad and transit agencies, as well as for communication infrastructure and power distribution equipment.

Fabricated Metals emphasizes a family-oriented culture and a tenured workforce with decades of experience. A dedicated research and development team continuously prototypes new products to meet evolving industry regulations, while a quality management system guides process improvements across all operations.

about:
Fabrication Specialties of Arkansas operates from Van Buren, Arkansas, as a division of Millar Partners, LLC. The company provides custom steel fabrication services for commercial and industrial clients from its facility at 1016 South 28th Street.

The shop handles structural steel fabrication including cambered beams, rolled members, metal pan stairs, columns, beams, and miscellaneous steel. It works with stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum, offering in-house machining, material processing, engineering, design and detailing, and structural steel erection for projects it fabricates. A CNC brake press supports forming operations.

The company serves commercial and industrial construction markets, with its welders and fabricators bringing over 50 years of combined experience to projects. It also accepts overflow fabrication packages from other shops that need additional capacity.

Fabrication Specialties of Arkansas emphasizes quality and service, partnering with customers during design and detailing to ensure fabricated work exceeds expectations.

name: Fabrication Syndicate
old_description: of individuals who have come together to create a company that can get any job done at any scale from start to finish. We use the most advanced design…
about:
Fabrication Syndicate operates in Las Vegas, Nevada, where a team of fabricators came together to build a shop capable of handling any project from start to finish. The business traces its roots to owner Scott Carter, who began working with metal at age 17 in Southern California before establishing the Las Vegas operation. A second owner, Mike, is also noted in customer feedback.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication with a focus on steel and aluminum welding, using a Millermatic 252 MIG welder for steel and a Miller Syncrowave 210 TIG welder for aluminum and stainless steel. Cutting is performed on an Arclight Dynamics 4'x8' CNC plasma table equipped with a tubing attachment for precise copes and miters, plus CNC engraving capability. Tube bending is handled by a hydraulic bender with a degree wheel and dedicated tube-bending software. In-house powder coating adds finish options. The facility also houses a 2-post 10,000 lb vehicle lift to support automotive fabrication such as lift kits, suspension work, and performance engine builds. Output ranges from dog cages, fish tank stands, and custom furniture to full custom vehicle builds.

Customers span automotive enthusiasts seeking suspension modifications or engine swaps, homeowners needing custom furniture or decorative metalwork, and pet or aquarium owners requiring specialized stands and cages. The shop serves both individual consumers and small commercial clients looking for one-off or low-volume metalwork.

The company emphasizes advanced CAD software for design through production, modern equipment to maintain precision, and a shop culture that includes a vehicle lift for ergonomic automotive work. They position themselves as a single-source provider able to take a project from concept to finished, powder-coated product.

name: Fabtech Custom Metal Fabrication & Welding
old_description: CNC Punching, Plasma Cutting, Oxy-Acetylene Cutting, & Brake Press Forming.
about:
Fabtech LLC operates from Prosperity, West Virginia, serving the surrounding region from a facility on Racetrack Road. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but presents itself as a limited liability company focused on custom metal fabrication.

The shop runs CNC punching, plasma cutting, oxy-acetylene cutting, and brake press forming equipment alongside TIG welding, tube bending, and stainless steel polishing and graining capabilities. An in-house powder coating line with an 8-by-8-by-20-foot batch oven allows finished parts to leave the facility fully coated. The company states it can produce anything from a single prototype to hundreds of units.

Customers span the restaurant industry, where Fabtech performs on-site repair of stainless countertops and sinks, as well as the automotive sector through custom aluminum and steel truck beds. The shop also builds NEMA-style electrical enclosures, modular control rooms, computer consoles, workstations, custom trailers, steel security products, handrails, and reproduces hard-to-find or obsolete parts.

Fabtech positions itself as a one-stop shop for metal fabrication, emphasizing a guarantee to rework any unsatisfactory result. It highlights its ability to fabricate stainless steel and aluminum assemblies with post-treatment polishing and re-graining as a differentiator in its market area.
